solution_summary: KPN used Azure AI Studio, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure Cosmos DB to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. “From the moment we embarked on this technology, we knew that we needed to treat it like a big experimenting exercise. We said to ourselves: let’s try it, experiment it and see where it takes us.”. Key implementation elements included Azure AI Studio provides the workspace for building, testing, and deploying the AI application; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Azure Cosmos DB stores application state and knowledge or interaction data; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Enterprise content from documents, meetings, websites, or internal systems is passed through retrieval and model services so users receive grounded answers inside the target workflow.
